name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Economic Affairs)
description: A government-backed small savings scheme launched under the 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' initiative, helping parents and legal guardians build a financial corpus for a girl child's higher education and marriage through long-term, tax-free savings.
benefits: Attractive interest rate (8.2% p.a. for Q2 FY 2026-27, compounded annually and revised quarterly), triple tax exemption under Section 80C (deposits, interest earned, and maturity amount are all tax-free). Deposits allowed from Rs. 250 to Rs. 1.5 lakh per financial year for 15 years, with the account maturing 21 years after opening.
eligibility: Account can be opened by a parent or legal guardian in the name of a girl child below 10 years of age
Maximum of two SSY accounts per family, one per girl child (exceptions for twins/triplets)
Available only to Indian citizen girl children
Account can be opened at any time from the birth of the girl child until she turns 10
documents_required: Identity proof of parent/guardian (Aadhaar, passport, or voter ID)
Passport-size photographs of the girl child and parent/guardian
how_to_apply: Visit any authorised bank branch or post office with the required documents, fill the SSY application form (Form-1), and make the first deposit (minimum Rs. 250) via cash, cheque, or demand draft.
